description: Schema facts CodeGen cannot read off the database. Referenced from mj.config.cjs via the TOP-LEVEL `additionalSchemaInfo` key (a path string). The path is resolved against the CodeGen process's CWD, not against mj.config.cjs, so run `pnpm run mj:codegen` from the repo root. A missing or unparseable file is a SILENT no-op: the ballot tables would get timestamp columns and Standards Ballot Elections would lose its IS-A parent, with nothing in the log.
_comment_Entities: Secrecy controls that live in entity metadata (plans/bizapps-voting-design.md §4.2).
CastBallot, BallotSelection and ContestRunningTally: TrackRecordChanges=false means no
__mj_CreatedAt/__mj_UpdatedAt columns (a ballot carries no time) and no Record Changes rows naming
the acting user. BallotAttribution (the Open/Confidential voter link) gets the same access lockdown.
Access: AutoAddPermissions=false creates the entity with NO role permissions (CodeGen's defaults
would otherwise grant UI read and Developer/Integration full CRUD), and every API surface flag is
off. Only the server engines, running as the system user, read or write these rows.
Why not IncludeInAPI=false, as the design first said: in MJ that flag also stops CodeGen generating
the base view and the create/update/delete procedures, so no server code could use the entity at
all. Permissions are the control that keeps the SQL objects and closes the API.
All of this is applied when CodeGen first CREATES the entity (MJ CodeGenLib
resolveCreationTimeEntityConfig / resolveCreationTimeAutoAddPermissions). Before that MJ fix,
TrackRecordChanges=false arrived only after the timestamp columns had been added, and the default
_comment_ISARelationships: Standards Ballot Elections IS-A Election, sharing the primary key (design §6, ElectionType.ElectionExtensionEntityID).
CodeGen never infers IS-A. ChildEntity is the BASE TABLE name: on the first run the child entity does not exist yet.
